notes: Secondary market prices are indicative algorithmic estimates from Notice.co combining private secondary trades, tender offers, and reference data. They are not fund marks, guaranteed bids, or ASC 820 fair values.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.note: Rapid secondary expansion across Series D and E rounds

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.note: Includes $150M August lot at cost + PPUs

spacex.name: SpaceX
spacex.note: Public secondary index following tender rounds; public vehicle SPCX launched June

revolut.name: Revolut
revolut.note: Large valuation re-rating following employee tender sale

chaos.name: CHAOS Industries
chaos.note: History begins mid-2025 on secondary platforms

fluidstack.name: Fluidstack
fluidstack.note: History begins early 2025; GPU cloud infra provider

boom.name: Boom
boom.caveat: Cliff drop in early 2026 is likely a share-basis break (recap, split, or different share class series), not a true 97% valuation loss.

chime.name: Chime
chime.note: Fintech digital banking; net flat over 2 years

discord.name: Discord
discord.note: Communication platform; spiked briefly in early 2026 before normalizing

klarna.name: Klarna
klarna.note: BNPL fintech; protracted secondary downtrend following initial IPO speculation

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.note: Global online payments and financial infrastructure platform; price doubled over 2Y and has plateaued near $65-70 since spring 2026.

figure.name: Figure AI
figure.note: Humanoid robotics developer; trades ~26% below its 2025 peak of ~$204.
figure.caveat: Chart is a step function: price sat at ~$13-17 until a single-day +1,021% re-mark on 2025-03-21 (to ~$150), so the 2Y change is dominated by one re-pricing, not gradual trade-driven appreciation. Note notice.co/c/figure is a different company (Figure Technology Solutions); Figure AI is notice.co/c/figure-ai.

canva.name: Canva
canva.note: Online design and visual communication platform; uptrend with a ~19% pullback from its 2026 high.

epic-games.name: Epic Games
epic-games.note: Fortnite maker and Unreal Engine owner; range-bound with a gentle downtrend, now near its 2Y low.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.note: Crypto exchange; price doubled over 2Y but has given back roughly 40% from its early-2026 plateau (~$45).
kraken.caveat: Chart is very noisy mid-2025 to early 2026 (21 daily moves >20%, plus a one-day print near $61); treat peak values as unreliable thin-market prints.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.note: Corporate card and spend-management fintech; staircase of step-ups with each round, now ~12% off its ~$151 high.

kalshi.name: Kalshi
kalshi.note: CFTC-regulated prediction-market exchange; Notice cites estimated revenue of ~$735M in 2025 vs ~$25M in 2024.
kalshi.caveat: Price moves in discrete steps (e.g. +304% on 2025-11-06) and has a brief outlier spike to ~$1,074; impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

whoop.name: Whoop
whoop.note: Wearable health and fitness tracking subscription company; has faded ~30% from its April 2026 re-mark high (~$11.46).
whoop.caveat: Price was flat at ~$1.1-1.6 for 18 months, then a single-day +880% re-mark on 2026-04-01 (to ~$11); the 2Y change is almost entirely that one step.

axiom-space.name: Axiom Space
axiom-space.note: Commercial space station and private astronaut mission company; steady decline, ~60% below its ~$212 high.
axiom-space.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap (the $1.00B figure does not reflect the current price).

motive-technologies.name: Motive Technologies
motive-technologies.note: Fleet management, telematics and AI dashcam platform for trucking and logistics (formerly KeepTruckin); Notice slug is /c/keeptruckin.

vast-data.name: Vast Data
vast-data.note: AI data platform and storage software vendor; flat ~$20 through 2025, then re-rated in January 2026.
vast-data.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap; includes a +148% one-day step on 2026-01-09.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.note: Wafer-scale AI chip maker; now publicly traded after its 2026 IPO and ~46% below its post-IPO high (~$311).
cerebras.caveat: Company has IPO'd (Notice shows an IPO marker); the chart splices pre-IPO secondary prices with public-market trading, so it is no longer a pure private secondary series. Notice slug is /c/cerebras-net.

apptronik.name: Apptronik
apptronik.note: Humanoid robot developer (Apollo); stepped up in stages through 2025 and has been flat-to-lower in 2026.
apptronik.caveat: Flat at ~$1.3 until a single-day +868% step on 2025-02-28, plus a +61% step on 2025-09-02; most of the 2Y change comes from these round re-marks.

anduril.name: Anduril
anduril.note: Defense technology company building autonomous systems and AI-enabled weapons platforms; one of the steadiest climbers in the set.
anduril.caveat: Two transient down-prints (~$30 and ~$60) around late June to July 2026 look like bad data points, not real drawdowns.

neuralink.name: Neuralink
neuralink.note: Brain-computer interface developer; grew slowly through 2025, then re-rated sharply in 2026 with volatile marks (peak ~$315).
neuralink.caveat: Several 2026 one-day swings of +50% to +127% and two brief dips to ~$170 look like mark/print noise.

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: AI inference chip and cloud provider; doubled over 2Y but ~26% below its 2026 peak (~$49.6).
groq.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.note: AI-powered answer and search engine; stepped up through 2025, now ~19% below its ~$73.6 peak. Notice slug is /c/perplexity-ai.
perplexity.caveat: Early-window glitch: a ~3-day dip to ~$3 in Nov 2024 followed by a +800% single-day recovery on 2024-12-12 (to ~$33); the earliest data points are unreliable.

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.note: GPU cloud and AI compute provider; drifted lower through mid-2025, then roughly tripled off the trough. Notice slug is /c/lambdalabs.

mercor.name: Mercor
mercor.note: AI-powered talent marketplace supplying expert contractors for AI model training and evaluation; ~14% below its ~$975 high.
mercor.caveat: Chart is two large steps (+632% on 2025-02-20 and +419% on 2025-10-10) separated by flat stretches, so the 2Y change reflects round re-marks rather than continuous trading.

colossal.name: Colossal Biosciences
colossal.note: De-extinction and genetic-engineering biotech; price has faded ~40% from its January 2025 re-mark high (~$26). Notice shows it as 'Colossal Bio' at /c/colossal.
colossal.caveat: Flat at ~$3 until a single-day +753% step on 2025-01-15; the entire 2Y gain comes from that step. impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

airwallex.name: Airwallex
airwallex.note: Cross-border payments and global financial platform for businesses; two round-driven step-ups (May 2025, Jan 2026) with a recent ~14% pullback.
airwallex.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

dataminr.name: Dataminr
dataminr.note: Real-time AI event and risk detection platform; ~25% below its early-2025 high (~$12.2), with a partial rebound off the early-2026 low.

coreweave.name: CoreWeave
coreweave.note: Specialized GPU cloud provider for AI training, inference and rendering workloads.
coreweave.caveat: Public since the March 2025 IPO; Notice series is private-market marks before the IPO marker, then public trading prices.

plaid.name: Plaid
plaid.note: Financial data APIs connecting consumer apps to banks for account linking and verification.
plaid.caveat: Step re-mark up in spring 2026 (~$145 to ~$240) then drift lower.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.note: AI voice models for text-to-speech, voice cloning and dubbing.
elevenlabs.caveat: Large step re-mark in early 2026 (~$15 to ~$54) following a financing.

zipline.name: Zipline
zipline.note: Autonomous drone delivery for medical supplies, pharma and consumer goods.
zipline.caveat: Step re-mark up in early 2026 (~$30 to ~$55).

oura.name: Oura
oura.note: Smart ring maker tracking sleep, activity and readiness with a subscription app.
oura.caveat: Step re-marks in late 2024 (~$7 to ~$26) and early 2026 (~$27 to ~$40 to ~$57).

crusoe.name: Crusoe
crusoe.note: Energy-focused AI cloud infrastructure with GPU compute and managed inference.

deel.name: Deel
deel.note: Global hiring, payroll and compliance platform (EOR and contractor management).

replit.name: Replit
replit.note: Browser-based AI coding and deployment platform.
replit.caveat: Step re-marks in late 2025 (~$40 to ~$80) and early 2026 (~$80 to ~$250).

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.note: Blockchain-based cross-border payments and crypto liquidity software built around XRP.
ripple.caveat: Step re-mark in mid-2025 (~$75 to ~$170); price has since fallen ~55% from the peak.

relativity-space.name: Relativity Space
relativity-space.note: Reusable orbital rocket maker (Terran R) using large-scale 3D printing and automation.
relativity-space.caveat: Price series stops around Jan 2025 at a recapitalization (Recap) marker, so the 2Y figure reflects only about the first 3 months of the window and is stale.

vanta.name: Vanta
vanta.note: Trust management platform automating SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance and security questionnaires.
vanta.caveat: Step re-mark in mid-2025 (~$12 to ~$18), partly given back since.

fivetran.name: Fivetran
fivetran.note: Managed data pipeline (ELT) connectors feeding cloud data warehouses and lakehouses.
fivetran.caveat: Price series ends at an M&A marker (~Oct 2025, dbt Labs merger), so it is stale; $1.62B is the price-implied value shown, while Notice lists $5.60B last-round valuation.

liquid-death.name: Liquid Death
liquid-death.note: Canned water and sparkling beverage brand with heavy-metal-style marketing.
liquid-death.caveat: Steady slide with an accelerated drop in the last few months.

arctic-wolf.name: Arctic Wolf
arctic-wolf.note: Managed detection and response cybersecurity services with a 24/7 security operations platform.

betterment.name: Betterment
betterment.note: Robo-advisor offering automated ETF portfolios, retirement accounts and cash management.

tanium.name: Tanium
tanium.note: Enterprise endpoint management and security platform for IT and security teams.
tanium.caveat: Step down mark in early 2026 (~$5.0 to ~$3.7), partly recovered since.

upgrade.name: Upgrade
upgrade.note: Digital consumer lending and banking platform (personal loans, credit cards, checking).
upgrade.caveat: Step re-mark in late 2025 (~$3.8 to ~$5.9) fully reversed by late 2026.

checkr.name: Checkr
checkr.note: Employment background screening and verification via dashboard and API.
checkr.caveat: Persistent downtrend with a step-down in early 2026.

automation-anywhere.name: Automation Anywhere
automation-anywhere.note: Robotic process automation platform with AI-driven workflow and document automation.
automation-anywhere.caveat: Step-down in early 2026 (~$5.5 to ~$4.2), flat since.

locus-robotics.name: Locus Robotics
locus-robotics.note: Warehouse automation using autonomous mobile robots for picking and fulfillment.
locus-robotics.caveat: Notice shows no price-implied market cap; $2.00B is the last-round valuation it falls back on.

path-robotics.name: Path Robotics
path-robotics.note: Autonomous AI-guided robotic welding cells for metal fabrication.
path-robotics.caveat: Notice shows no implied valuation or market cap for this company.

ayar-labs.name: Ayar Labs
ayar-labs.note: Silicon photonics optical I/O chiplets for AI and high-performance computing interconnects.
ayar-labs.caveat: Step re-marks in late 2024 (~$10 to ~$25), early 2026 (~$32 to ~$50) and mid-2026 (~$57 to ~$80); $3.75B is the last-round valuation Notice falls back on.

tradeshift.name: Tradeshift
tradeshift.note: B2B invoicing, procurement and accounts-payable software with supply chain finance.
tradeshift.caveat: Notice shows no price-implied market cap; $2.70B is the last-round valuation it falls back on and is far above what the current price implies.

equipmentshare-com.name: EquipmentShare
equipmentshare-com.note: Construction equipment rental and sales company with its T3 telematics platform.
equipmentshare-com.caveat: IPO marker in early 2026 (~Jan); the series is public trading after that, with a spike to ~$34 at listing that has since faded.

tensorwave.name: TensorWave
tensorwave.note: AMD Instinct-based AI cloud offering bare-metal GPU nodes and managed Kubernetes.
tensorwave.caveat: Basis break: series starts at ~$0.05 and jumps to ~$17-19 in early 2025 (first real mark), so the displayed +77,122.89% is not meaningful; measured from the ~$17.5 first mark the gain is about +125%. Another step re-mark in 2026 (~$19.7 to ~$38).

radiant-industries.name: Radiant Industries
radiant-industries.note: Portable nuclear microreactors for off-grid, remote and backup power (listed as Radiant Nuclear).
radiant-industries.caveat: Step re-marks in late 2024, mid-2025 and early 2026 (~$21 to ~$42), then a ~35% pullback from the peak.

learneo.name: Learneo
learneo.note: Education technology holding company behind Course Hero and related study and writing tools.
learneo.caveat: Steady downtrend; -49.44% sits right at the lagging/distressed boundary.

flock.name: Flock Safety
flock.note: Connected license-plate-reader cameras and sensors with cloud software for local governments, schools and businesses.
flock.caveat: Step re-mark in early 2025 (~$9.5 to ~$15) and a peak near ~$19 in mid-2025, since fully retraced to near the starting level.

standard-bots.name: Standard Bots
standard-bots.note: AI-enabled robotic arms for factory automation that learn tasks from demonstration.
standard-bots.caveat: Single large step re-mark in early 2026 (~$6 to ~$30); price was flat at ~$6-7 before that.
